description:

I want standard Romanian technical terms, not mixed English phrasing, so please adapt industry vocabulary accordingly. No item can be skipped.

Workflow I expect

• You translate all customer-visible fields, leaving non-textual data untouched. 
• You return a single UTF-8 CSV that can be imported directly into my existing WooCommerce setup. 
• Before we start, you provide a sample of 20 translated products so I can confirm style and terminology. 
• Along with your proposal, tell me your total price and realistic turnaround time for the entire file.

Quality matters: translation must read naturally to Romanian buyers yet stay 100 % faithful to the original tech data.

title: Automated AI Video Social Posting
description:
I need a complete workflow that turns the text, images and basic offer information I provide into short, faceless videos with an AI voice-over, on-screen captions and royalty-free stock footage. Once rendered, each video must be published automatically to the major platforms I use:

• Instagram, Facebook, TikTok 
• YouTube, LinkedIn, X (Twitter) 
• Pinterest, Snapchat, Telegram 

Every video and its accompanying post should clearly surface my product or service details, price, brand story, customer benefits, current offer, website link and a direct call-to-action. Format, length, aspect ratio, thumbnails, captions and hashtags have to be adjusted so they look native on each channel.

Here is what I expect as deliverables: 
1. A repeatable script, no-code scenario or lightweight app that accepts my inputs and produces the finished video. 
2. An integration layer (API, Zapier, Make.com or similar) that publishes the content to all nine channels, either instantly or on a schedule I can set. 
3. Simple documentation or a walk-through video so I can run the process myself after hand-over.

The solution can leverage tools such as OpenAI, Pictory, Synthesia, Runway, FFmpeg, Meta/YouTube APIs, etc. – I’m flexible as long as licensing is respected and the final flow is reliable and easy to maintain.

Please propose the tech stack you prefer, the steps you will automate and an estimated timeline for a first working version.

title: AI Home Health Compliance Platform
description:
**Project Title: Custom AI-Powered Home Health Compliance & Operations Software**

We are seeking an experienced AI software developer or development team to build a comprehensive, web-based AI application for our Medicare-certified home health agency's **internal use only**.

The software should have a modern, professional dashboard with interactive charts, graphs, color-coded alerts, patient management, and automated AI-powered workflows.

**Required Features & Modules:**

1. **AI Referral & Intake Management** – Analyze referral documents, extract patient information, identify missing documentation, and assist with admission decisions.
2. **AI Clinical Chart Review** – Automatically review OASIS assessments, physician orders, face-to-face encounters, Plan of Care (CMS-485), nursing notes, and therapy documentation.
3. **OASIS Quality Assurance** – Detect incomplete assessments, inconsistencies, potential coding errors, and documentation deficiencies.
4. **Intelligent Medical Coding** – AI-assisted ICD-10 diagnosis coding, sequencing, HCPCS review, and PDGM-related validation.
5. **Medicare Compliance & RCD Review** – Evaluate homebound status, skilled necessity, medical necessity, physician certification, and pre-claim review readiness.
6. **Recertification & Discharge Assistant** – Track certification periods, evaluate clinical documentation, and generate draft recertification justifications.
7. **Authorization Management** – Review payer requirements, prepare authorization packets, identify missing records, and draft appeal letters.
8. **Denial Prevention & Billing Readiness** – Cross-check orders, eligibility, documentation, and coding to identify potential claim denials.
9. **Clinical Documentation Improvement** – Identify inconsistencies, missing signatures, incorrect orders, and weak clinical documentation.
10. **AI Clinical Assistant** – Suggest patient-specific goals, interventions, patient education, and documentation improvements for clinician review.
11. **Scheduling & Field Operations** – Assist with clinician assignments, scheduling, route optimization, and travel-time planning.
12. **Analytics & Reporting Dashboard** – Display compliance scores, audit findings, patient status trends performance graphs downloadable reports.
13. **Document & Patient Management** – Secure PDF uploads document classification organized patient charts AI-powered document search.
14. **Security & Administration** – HIPAA-compliant architecture role-based access audit logs secure cloud storage data protection.

Additionally:
- We are particularly interested in developers who have built similar platforms before and can showcase their work or provide a demo of relevant past projects to demonstrate their expertise in this domain.

**Technical Requirements:**

- Integration with an existing advanced AI model through API.
- Ability to analyze multiple clinical documents together.
- Findings supported by document/page references and applicable CMS guidance.
- Human review and approval of clinical and coding recommendations.
- Clean modern responsive interface scalable architecture for additional modules future EHR integration full ownership of source code database application.

Once you receive the PDF statements, please perform a straightforward ratio analysis—no audit, just a professional review—and draft the letter accordingly. 

Deliverables (all in PDF):

title: Реалистичная генерация интерьеров по референсам в 4K
description:
Реалистичная генерация интерьеров по референсам в 4K 
Предоставляем референсы интерьеров, реальные фотографии материалов и, при наличии, готовые текстуры. 
Необходимо максимально реалистично интегрировать фактуру в интерьер, сохранив её цвет, рисунок, масштаб и рельеф. Изображения предназначены для печати в каталогах, публикации на сайте и использования в презентациях. 
**Требования:** разрешение 4K и выше, фотореализм, высокая детализация, отсутствие AI-артефактов, корректная перспектива и освещение. 
Простая генерация в ChatGPT без проверки и доработки не интересует. Важно профессиональное владение нейросетями, понимание их возможностей и ограничений, умение выявлять и устранять ошибки генерации. Опыт работы с интерьерами необязателен. 
Первое задание — бесплатное тестовое, ориентировочно на 10–15 минут для опытного специалиста. Результат можно предоставить ссылкой на облачное хранилище в хорошем качестве. 
**Условия сотрудничества:** ищем постоянного подрядчика. Объём работы большой, много коллекций и артикулов. 
Ориентировочная стоимость единичного изображения высокого качества — 1500–2000 руб. Стоимость пакетной генерации (60–100 изображений) обсуждается индивидуально с учётом объёма, сложности замены материалов, различий между фактурами и необходимости корректировки промптов. 
Готовы рассмотреть ваши расценки на Kwork с учётом объёма и сложности задач.

analysis.summary_ru: Заказчик ищет постоянного подрядчика для пакетной AI-генерации фотореалистичных интерьеров с интеграцией референсных материалов в 4K. Это генерация изображений и дизайн-работа, а не разработка из списка услуг Yakov.

title: AI Automation System Development – Workflow & Integration
description:

### Requirements

### Working Arrangement

### How to Apply

We look forward to collaborating with someone reliable, technically skilled, and interested in long-term cooperation.

title: AI Developer to Build a Connected AI Platform for SME's
description:
We're Lamp, an AI department for service businesses in Egypt. We're starting with SMEs (clinics, real estate brokerages, academies and finance-related services) and we have clients waiting. This is a real project, not a test. The full scope is in the attached document.

What we're building
One platform with the Executive Brain at the center, and modules that plug into it: Finance & Accounting, Reception, Sales, Marketing and People. Operations is designed per business. Nothing here works in isolation, and that's the point. Every module reads from and writes to one shared data layer, so they feed each other. Reception's conversations tell Marketing what customers actually ask. A closed deal in Sales triggers an invoice in Finance and a welcome message from Reception. Marketing knows which ad brought a paying customer, not just a click, and Finance turns that into the real cost per customer. That connection is the product.

The Executive Brain
The owner's branded app, installable on web and phone, and the hardest part of the build. Each module has its own chat, and a CEO chat queries all of them and returns one answer, in Egyptian Arabic or by voice note. Every number is calculated from real data, never generated by the model, and every answer cites its source. The dashboard shows a health score per department with drill-down from the whole company to a single customer, an Approval Center for one-tap approval of discounts, payments and budget changes, and an impact tracker against the client's baseline. Every module sends its notifications through the Brain, with priority levels, a daily cap and quiet hours.

The modules
Finance & Accounting is our flagship. It connects to the client's existing accounting software, drafts invoices automatically, submits e-invoices and e-receipts to the Egyptian Tax Authority, matches payments across InstaPay, wallets, cards and bank transfers, and produces live financial statements, a 13-week cash forecast and what-if scenarios. Reception answers WhatsApp, social DMs and calls 24/7, manages bookings with a waitlist, recovers missed calls and hands chats to staff with a summary. Sales contacts every lead within a minute or two, qualifies and scores them, runs follow-ups that stop when the lead replies, and keeps the CRM updated from calls and chats. Marketing builds the content calendar from real customer conversations and ties ad performance to actual revenue. People gives staff an assistant that answers from company procedures, plus onboarding and leave requests on WhatsApp.

Quality
Our internal layer that watches every deployment. Every AI action is logged with what it did and why. Quality scores each module on a few KPIs, reviews samples plus anything flagged, catches wrong answers and frustrated customers, and every change is tested on saved real conversations before it goes live.

Ground rules
The AI never moves money. Numbers are calculated, not generated. Arabic comes first (Egyptian Arabic, Franco-Arabic and English, in text and voice). Access is least-privilege, and all accounts stay in the client's name.

Who we're looking for
A developer or small team with production experience in LLM agents and retrieval, the WhatsApp Business Platform, API integrations (CRM, accounting software, Meta and Google Ads), backend and databases, and an installable web/mobile app. Arabic NLP, voice AI or Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoicing experience is a strong plus.

Why work with us
Real clients and real deployments. We launch in stages for each client, so the work keeps coming. If you deliver well, you become our go-to team for every client project after this one. This is long-term work, not a one-off.

How to apply
Start your bid with the word "Lamp". Tell us which building blocks in the attached scope you've built before, with links or examples. Give a total estimate plus a breakdown by build stage, and tell us if you're solo or a team and who does what. Shortlisted candidates get an interview here on Freelancer, then a small paid milestone before the main build.

title: Mortgage Lead-Gen Platform Pilot Build
description:
I’m spinning up a proof-of-concept for KeepEasy Finance that lets Australian home buyers book a call with one of our brokers and, behind the scenes, creates a lead inside BrokerEngine using dummy data. The pilot will never touch production credentials—once the flow works, we’ll swap in live keys ourselves.

Here’s the flow I want to see:
• Prospect lands on a responsive page, enters basic contact details, then chooses a time slot that aligns with the broker’s Sydney schedule. 
• On submission, the system fires a test payload to BrokerEngine (or clearly logs the API call) so we can confirm the mapping. 
• Both prospect and broker receive confirmation emails. 

Deliverables:
• Front-end landing page + form. 
• Calendar/booking integration (Calendly, Google Calendar API, or similar). 
• Backend script demonstrating the BrokerEngine link with dummy data. 
• Clear deploy notes and a short screen-share walkthrough. 

Acceptance criteria:
1. A test lead appears in BrokerEngine’s sandbox or in a logged JSON object matching their schema. 
2. Email confirmations render correctly in AEST. 
3. Code is clean, commented, and can be redeployed with live keys in under an hour. 

I need at least three hours of overlap with Sydney business hours each day. Experience with Australian mortgage broking or BrokerEngine will earn extra points, but solid API integration work speaks for itself. Let me know the tech stack you’d choose and link me to a similar integration you’ve shipped.

title: Bespoke API-Powered Report Builder
description:
I am looking to develop a bespoke web-based application for my business that will allow me to create professional, customised reports by integrating data from multiple third-party websites and platforms via their APIs.

The application should have a flexible report-building interface, allowing me to design and customise my own report templates rather than relying on fixed, pre-designed formats.

Key functionality required:

API integrations: Ability to pull data automatically from several different third-party websites and platforms via their APIs and populate relevant sections of my reports.

Custom text fields: Ability to create editable text boxes throughout the report, allowing me to add my own commentary, descriptions and professional opinions.

Dropdown menus: Customisable dropdown fields with predefined options to ensure consistency and speed up report completion.

Photo uploads: Dedicated sections where users can upload photographs, arrange them within the report and add descriptions or captions.

Custom report templates: Ability to create, save and amend bespoke report templates, including different layouts and sections depending on the report type.

Dynamic content: The ability for information retrieved through APIs, dropdown selections and manual inputs to automatically populate the relevant sections of the report.

Report generation: Ability to generate a final, professionally formatted report, ideally in PDF format, with consistent branding, layouts, headers and footers.

User management: Ideally, multiple users should be able to log in, access the platform and create reports, with appropriate permissions.

The overall objective is to build a flexible, scalable reporting platform that combines automated data retrieval with manual input, allowing us to produce our own bespoke reports efficiently.

I am looking for a developer who can advise on the best technology and architecture for this project, assist with API integrations and deliver a fully functioning application with an intuitive, user-friendly interface.

title: Fintech Crypto Compliance Framework
description:
I run a digital-asset platform that is preparing to expand across the United States and Canada, and I need a specialist who can own our end-to-end compliance program. The mandate covers everything from drafting policies to hands-on AML operations, with immediate attention on:

• Robust customer (KYC) and business (KYB) onboarding checks, including sanctions screening 
• Real-time transaction monitoring, alert review, investigation, and SAR preparation 
• Creation and periodic refresh of policies, partner due-diligence files, and staff training material 

What the day-to-day looks like 
You will design and maintain the internal policy suite, implement screening and monitoring workflows, and act as the primary liaison when banking partners, payment processors, or regulators send RFIs or schedule periodic reviews. Close collaboration with engineering and product is essential so that compliance controls are embedded directly into our codebase and operational playbooks.

Key success criteria 
— Up-to-date, regulator-ready AML / KYC / KYB policies aligned to U.S. FinCEN, OSC, and provincial guidance 
— Automated screening rules live in our chosen tools (e.g., Chainalysis, ComplyAdvantage, or similar) with clear escalation paths 
— Training deck and short quiz rolled out to every employee, with completion tracked 
— A complete audit trail for suspicious activity investigations, from initial alert through final filing 

If you have a proven track record building crypto compliance programs, are comfortable navigating North American regulations, and can communicate complex requirements to both engineers and executives, I’d like to hear how you would tackle this engagement and your proposed timeline.
